title: 本地 Codex plugin 必须显式从 GitHub 源拉包安装
prompt: PMWorkspace 作为本地 GitHub plugin 使用时，只能在用户明确升级后从 GitHub 拉取并安装，不能在普通产品工作流中静默更新。

expected.gate: 本地 plugin 显式升级
required_behaviors: pmw-update-check 只发现更新并输出 UPGRADE_COMMAND
auto_upgrade 不为 true 时不静默执行升级
pmw-upgrade --host codex-plugin 从 repo_url / PMW_REPO_URL 克隆源码
pmw-upgrade --host codex-plugin 从克隆结果构建并安装本地 plugin 包
forbidden_behaviors: 普通产品工作流静默 git pull 或覆盖本地 plugin
本地 plugin 升级只复用旧缓存而不读取配置的 Git 源
默认依赖 Codex 官方推荐插件更新入口

contract_checks.contains: The local GitHub plugin path is explicit-upgrade only
It must not silently pull code

command: tmp=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT; git clone "$PWD" "$tmp/src" >/dev/null 2>&1; (cd "$tmp/src" && git config user.email pmw-eval@example.com && git config user.name 'PMW Eval' && printf '9.9.9\n' > VERSION && git add VERSION && git commit -m 'Eval remote version' >/dev/null); PATH="/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin" PMW_REPO_URL="$tmp/src" CODEX_PLUGINS_DIR="$tmp/plugins" CODEX_MARKETPLACE_PATH="$tmp/marketplace.json" PMW_HOME="$tmp/state" bin/pmw-upgrade --host codex-plugin > "$tmp/out" 2>&1; cat "$tmp/out"; grep -q "PMW_UPGRADE_SOURCE $tmp/src" "$tmp/out"; test "$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "$tmp/plugins/plugins/pmworkspace/skills/pmworkspace-shared/VERSION")" = '9.9.9'; test -f "$tmp/plugins/plugins/pmworkspace/.codex-plugin/plugin.json"; grep -q '"name": "pmworkspace"' "$tmp/marketplace.json"

tmp=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT; printf '99.0.0
' > "$tmp/VERSION"; printf 'aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
' > "$tmp/REVISION"; out=$(PMW_HOME="$tmp/state" PMW_REMOTE_VERSION_URL="file://$tmp/VERSION" PMW_REMOTE_REVISION_URL="file://$tmp/REVISION" PMW_REPO_URL="https://invalid.local/PMWorkspace.git" bin/pmw-update-check --force); printf '%s
' "$out"; grep -q '^UPGRADE_AVAILABLE ' <<< "$out"; grep -q '^UPGRADE_COMMAND pmw-upgrade --host ' <<< "$out"; test ! -d "$tmp/state/plugins"
